difference_witness.definition: For q>=2 and sigma in {+1,-1}, set r_j^(sigma)(q)=sigma*(q-1)! if j=q and 0 otherwise.
difference_witness.fixed_index_property: For every fixed j, r_j^(sigma)(q)=0 for every q>j, hence lim_{q->infinity} r_j^(sigma)(q)=0.
difference_witness.logical_conclusion: The proposition [for every fixed j, r_j(q)->0] does not imply uniform/all-index control of the weighted aggregate. A moving-index or otherwise n-uniform bound is logically necessary for that gluing step.
difference_witness.moving_index_calculation: At n=q only j=q is nonzero, so sum_{j=1}^q w_{q,j} r_j^(sigma)(q)=sigma*(-1)^(q-1). Its magnitude is exactly 1 for every q.
not_claimed: that actual Bombieri-Lagarias remainders have diagonal factorial spikes
that RH-ANA-003-ABEL-001 fixed-n candidate is true or false
that the required n-uniform theorem is impossible
any new result on Li coefficient signs or the Riemann Hypothesis
difference_witness.opposite_worlds: sigma=+1 and sigma=-1 satisfy the identical fixed-index convergence property but give opposite order-one moving-index weighted aggregates.
difference_witness.verification: Hand algebra is exact. A rational-arithmetic calibration for q=2..12 and both signs matched the formula in all 22 cases; computation is calibration only, not proof.

primary_source_binding.visual_verification: Author-hosted PDF pages 8-10 inspected; page 8 states the regularized formula, pages 9-10 justify the fixed-n cutoff limit using PNT error control.

summation_compatibility_witness.local_block_definition: For fixed j, cutoff prime-power block sum_{m<=X} Lambda(m)(log m)^(j-1)/m minus (log X)^j/j, retained with its exact regularization.
summation_compatibility_witness.nested_limit_order: FOR EACH FIXED n>=1: preserve each j regularized cutoff X=1/epsilon -> infinity with matching (log X)^j/j counterterm; then form the finite j=1..n combination. No n->infinity interchange is source-authorized by this witness.
summation_compatibility_witness.source_accumulation_method: Bombieri-Lagarias Theorem 2 Guinand-Weil arithmetic formula: for each fixed n, finite j-combination of regularized von Mangoldt cutoff limits with explicit logarithmic counterterms, plus explicit archimedean/zeta terms.

transfer.cheapest_falsifier: Diagonal moving-index tail family; a single exact family with fixed-index convergence but order-one moving-index aggregate defeats the bare local-to-global implication.
transfer.common_abstraction: A fixed-parameter/local estimate can be mathematically correct while failing the downstream global/all-parameter consumer because an unsummed or moving-index tail is uncontrolled.
disanalogies: NS superlevel mass is nonnegative; the RH arithmetic side is signed and renormalized, so cancellation can be essential.
NS exhausts spatial radius R at fixed time; RH has a cutoff limit plus a separate coefficient index n, so the dangerous operation is quantifier/limit transport rather than spatial monotonicity.
Absolute summability is not required by the RH fixed-n candidate and would be stronger than its natural-order claim.
The diagonal remainder witness is abstract and is not asserted to satisfy actual prime-number-theorem remainder estimates.
enabling_assumptions: Use only the exact scoped NS R6 conclusion: the fixed-time superlevel estimate retains an unbounded spatial-radius factor R.
Treat RH-ANA-003-ABEL-001 exactly as frozen: fixed n first, natural-order endpoint limit second, NO_N_UNIFORMITY and NO_SERIES_REORDERING_OR_REGROUPING.
Use Bombieri-Lagarias Theorem 2 only as a fixed-n arithmetic identity with exact regularization; do not infer any n-uniform remainder estimate from its fixed-n proof.
transfer.predicted_principle: Even a future proof that every fixed-n Abel identity is correct cannot, by itself, support all-index Li positivity. The missing bridge is an n-uniform binomial/factorial-weighted tail or cancellation certificate in the exact regularization/order used by the target consumer.
